title: Searchable shared work queue
testKey: Type part of a task title, then choose a status or owner and change the sort. The visible result count and task rows should update together; Clear Filters should restore the full queue.

css: .queue{font-family:Inter,ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif;background:#0f1722;color:#eef3fa;border:1px solid #28384d;border-radius:18px;padding:18px}.queue header{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-start;gap:12px}.kicker{margin:0 0 3px;color:#90a4bd;font-size:11px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.14em}.queue h2{margin:0;font-size:24px}.result-count{color:#b9c8db;background:#1a2636;border-radius:999px;padding:6px 10px;font-size:11px}.controls{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(180px,1.8fr) repeat(3,minmax(120px,1fr)) auto;gap:8px;align-items:end;margin:16px 0}.controls label{display:grid;gap:5px}.controls label>span{font-size:10px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#91a5bf}.controls input,.controls select,.clear{box-sizing:border-box;width:100%;border:1px solid #30435d;border-radius:10px;background:#151f2d;color:#eaf1f8;padding:9px 10px;min-height:38px}.clear{width:auto;cursor:pointer;font-weight:800;white-space:nowrap}.clear:hover{border-color:#6385ad}.queue-list{display:grid;gap:8px}.task-card{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) auto;gap:10px;padding:12px;background:#151f2d;border:1px solid #26374d;border-radius:12px}.task-card h3{margin:0;font-size:14px;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}.task-meta{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:6px;color:#98abc2;font-size:11px}.task-status{align-self:start;padding:4px 8px;border-radius:999px;background:#24354b;color:#d2dfef;font-size:10px;font-weight:800;text-transform:uppercase}.empty{padding:24px;text-align:center;color:#91a4bd;border:1px dashed #34475f;border-radius:12px}@media(max-width:850px){.controls{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.clear{width:100%}}@media(max-width:520px){.controls{grid-template-columns:1fr}.task-card{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
js: const $=s=>root.querySelector(s);const search=$('[data-search]'),status=$('[data-status]'),owner=$('[data-owner]'),sort=$('[data-sort]'),list=$('[data-queue-list]'),count=$('[data-result-count]');const ownerOf=t=>t.owner||t.assignee||'Unassigned';const dueOf=t=>t.dueDate||t.due||t.deadline||'';const dateValue=v=>{const n=Date.parse(v||'');return Number.isFinite(n)?n:Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER;};const refill=(select,values,label)=>{const current=select.value;select.innerHTML='';const first=document.createElement('option');first.value='';first.textContent=label;select.appendChild(first);values.forEach(v=>{const o=document.createElement('option');o.value=v;o.textContent=v;select.appendChild(o);});select.value=values.includes(current)?current:'';};const render=()=>{const tasks=api.getState('tasks')||[];const statuses=[...new Set(tasks.map(t=>t.status||'Todo'))].sort((a,b)=>String(a).localeCompare(String(b)));const owners=[...new Set(tasks.map(ownerOf))].sort((a,b)=>String(a).localeCompare(String(b)));refill(status,statuses,'All statuses');refill(owner,owners,'All owners');const q=search.value.trim().toLowerCase();let rows=tasks.filter(t=>(!q||String(t.title||'').toLowerCase().includes(q))&&(!status.value||String(t.status||'Todo')===status.value)&&(!owner.value||String(ownerOf(t))===owner.value));rows=[...rows].sort((a,b)=>sort.value==='due'?(dateValue(dueOf(a))-dateValue(dueOf(b))||String(a.title||'').localeCompare(String(b.title||''))):String(a.title||'').localeCompare(String(b.title||'')));count.textContent=rows.length+' result'+(rows.length===1?'':'s');list.innerHTML='';if(!rows.length){const e=document.createElement('div');e.className='empty';e.textContent='No tasks match these filters.';list.appendChild(e);return;}rows.forEach(t=>{const card=document.createElement('article');card.className='task-card';const main=document.createElement('div');const h=document.createElement('h3');h.textContent=t.title||'Untitled task';const meta=document.createElement('div');meta.className='task-meta';const own=document.createElement('span');own.textContent='Owner: '+ownerOf(t);const due=document.createElement('span');due.textContent='Due: '+(dueOf(t)||'—');meta.append(own,due);main.append(h,meta);const badge=document.createElement('span');badge.className='task-status';badge.textContent=t.status||'Todo';card.append(main,badge);list.appendChild(card);});};[search,status,owner,sort].forEach(el=>el.addEventListener(el===search?'input':'change',render));$('[data-clear]').addEventListener('click',()=>{search.value='';status.value='';owner.value='';sort.value='title';render();api.log(3,'Work queue filters cleared');});render();const unsubscribe=api.subscribe(render);
